questions.subject: ALGEBRA_I
questions.learningObjective: choose the equation that models a design constraint
questions.stem: Priya's design brief for a steel truss says the shop has 18 metres of angle stock and each cut member needs 2.5 metres. Which equation finds how many members fit?

options.text: n = 18 divided by 2.5, since each member uses 2.5 metres of the 18
n = 18 minus 2.5, treating the leftover stock as one more member
options.misconception: subtracts the member length from the total instead of dividing

options.text: n = 2.5 times 18, multiplying stock by member length rather than dividing
options.misconception: multiplies the two quantities instead of dividing

options.text: n = 18 plus 2.5, adding the member length to the available stock
options.misconception: adds the member length to the stock instead of dividing

questions.explanation: Each member consumes 2.5 metres, so the count is 18 divided by 2.5. Subtracting, multiplying, or adding the two quantities never counts how many whole members fit in the stock.
questions.hint: Divide the available length by the length of one member.

options.text: The ramp has no slope limit, since a ratio is not a number
options.misconception: treats a stated ratio as giving no constraint

questions.explanation: A rise of 1 for a run of 12 is a slope of 1 divided by 12. Reading 12 as the slope, using only the vertical unit, or ignoring the stated ratio misreads the restriction.

options.text: h = 25, because 90 minus 15 is 75 and 75 divided by 3 is 25

options.misconception: treats an upper limit as an exact equality

questions.learningObjective: find the input at which a linear model reaches zero

options.text: At 5 seconds, because 5 is the coefficient of the time term

options.text: The slope is 4/6, since the feed change is listed second
options.misconception: divides the change in x by the change in y

options.text: The slope is 1.5, since 6 divided by 4 is 1.5
The slope is 10, since 6 plus 4 is 10
options.misconception: adds the two changes instead of dividing them

options.text: The slope is 0.25, since 4 divided by 6 is 0.25
options.misconception: inverts rise and run when computing the slope
